d_helix_industry_desc: Modified cellships suited for manufacturing have been added to the helix.
d_helix_mining_desc: Modified cellships suited for mining and fabrication are added to the helix.
d_helix_park_desc: An expansion to the helix consisting of modular cellships filled with large hydroponics bays.
d_helix_research_desc: An expansion to the helix consisting of modular cellships filled with laboratories and other experimental labs.
d_helix_trade_desc: Modified cellships suited for docking and commerce have been added to the helix.
d_herding_grounds_desc: The ceremonial meeting place for the Grazerite elders. Where the elders of the leading tribes meet once a year to celebrate important festivals.
d_human_museum_desc: A museum dedicated to the triumph of humanity over all obstacles.
d_iconia_ruins_desc: Buried deep beneath the devastated surface of Iconia lies the ruins of a vast Iconian transport facility.
d_iconian_gateway_deposit_desc: An Iconian gateway is a technology developed by the ancient Iconians 200,000 years ago. These gateways allowed instantaneous travel over enormous distances, enabling the Iconians to travel across the galaxy without ships.
d_iconian_ruins_deposit_desc: A site of vast archeological interest to our scientists having found evidence of Iconian technology.
d_idrin_biome_desc: Transplanted from the surface of numerous worlds, these artificial biomes provide a temporary hunting ground for those onboard the lodge.
d_idrin_haven_desc: Individual hangar bays offer resupply and recuperation facilities for hunting parties, as well as facilities for hunting crews to find replacements and information about new hunting grounds.
d_idrin_refuge_desc: A vast arboretum stocked with dangerous and exotic wildlife for hunting.
d_idrin_treasure_desc: Displaying trophies from the greatest hunters, this entire section of the lodge is dedicated to those hunters who have defeated the most worthy prey, and taken their technology and skins for their own.
d_imperial_hq_ruins_desc: Imperial Command has been destroyed after Earth was attacked.
d_janus_vi_1_desc: Vast mining deposits are found here in the tunnels under Janus VI, ready for mining.
d_janus_vi_2_desc: Vast mining deposits are found here in the tunnels under Janus VI, ready for mining.
d_janus_vi_3_desc: Vast mining deposits are found here in the tunnels under Janus VI, ready for mining.
d_janus_vi_4_desc: Vast mining deposits are found here in the tunnels under Janus VI, ready for mining.
d_janus_vi_mineral_rich_caves_desc: Vast mining deposits are found here in the tunnels under Janus VI, ready for mining.
d_janus_vi_pergium_rich_caves_desc: Vast pergium deposits are found here in the tunnels under Janus VI, ready for mining.
d_janus_vi_vault_of_tomorrow_desc: A massive vault whose purpose seems to be unknown.
d_jevonite_deposit_desc: Jevonite is an exquisitely beautiful gemstone. It is very rare and prized on many worlds and said by many to be breathtaking in appearance.
d_karemma_kecemen_desc: Kecemen is a large urban metropolis that is home to the Karemma, and has been structured orderly since it's inception centuries ago allowing substantial growth.
d_karrs_biome_desc: Transplanted from the surface of numerous worlds, these artificial biomes provide a temporary hunting ground for those onboard the lodge.
d_karrs_haven_desc: Individual hangar bays offer resupply and recuperation facilities for hunting parties, as well as facilities for hunting crews to find replacements and information about new hunting grounds.
d_karrs_treasure_desc: Displaying trophies from the greatest hunters, this entire section of the lodge is dedicated to those hunters who have defeated the most worthy prey, and taken their technology and skins for their own.
d_kemocite_caverns_desc: Raw unrefined Kemocite deposits that require extraction and refinement.
d_kobali_city_desc: The capital city of the Kobali, known for its biological research and necrogenesis.
d_ktaria_arpasian_range_desc: This popular mountain range on the northern continent is well known for its high wind speed and frequent hail.
d_ktaria_black_grape_vineyard_desc: Famous across the quadrant, the wine produced from the black grapes at this vineyard is enjoyed by all.
d_ktaria_ktarian_glaciers_desc: A popular destination for scientists and tourists alike.
d_ktaria_scenic_moonrise_desc: Made popular by holo-simulations, these scenes have been described as beautiful by even the most hopeless romantics.
d_kurill_treetop_desc: A large treetop village created by the pre-forced evolution marsupial Vorta that existed before the Founder's evolved their race.
d_kyana_city_desc: An architectural masterpiece, Kyana City is the pride of Kyana Prime.
d_lab_engineering_desc: Rare crystals and minerals can be found within the crystal caves. An engineering laboratory could experiment with them.
d_lab_physics_desc: Mysterious happenings occur here, and the laws of physics seem to bend. A physics laboratory could investigate more.
d_lab_society_desc: The fauna and flora in this region are fruitful and filled with lots of evolutionary advantages. A biological laboratory could investigate more.
d_leroth_islands_desc: A group of island landmasses in the world's southern hemisphere, just south of the continent Kesta'al.
d_luna_armstrong_city_desc: Armstrong City is situated on the banks of Lake Armstrong, a man-made body of water within a nearby crater.
d_luna_monitor_relay_desc: One of Earth's first off-world installations, providing monitoring facilities throughout the sol sector.
d_luna_orpheus_desc: Orpheus Mining Colony is a mobile mining structure capable of launching itself off the surface of the moon and landing in a new area.
d_luna_sea_of_clouds_2_desc: Mare Nubium is a lunar mare in the Nubium basin on the Moon's near side. The mare is located just to the southeast of Oceanus Procellarum.
d_luna_sea_of_clouds_desc: Mare Nubium is a lunar mare in the Nubium basin on the Moon's near side. The mare is located just to the southeast of Oceanus Procellarum.
d_luna_sea_of_tranquillity_2_desc: The Sea of Tranquility is a lunar mare that sits within the Tranquillitatis basin on the Moon. It is the first location on another world to be visited by humans.
d_luna_sea_of_tranquillity_desc: The Sea of Tranquility is a lunar mare that sits within the Tranquillitatis basin on the Moon. It is the first location on another world to be visited by humans.
d_luna_tycho_city_desc: Tycho City is one of several lunar landmarks which are large enough to be seen from Earth during the daytime.
d_luna_tycho_crater_2_desc: Tycho is a prominent lunar impact crater located in the southern lunar highlands, named after the Danish astronomer Tycho Brahe. It is estimated to be 108 million years old.
d_luna_tycho_crater_desc: Tycho is a prominent lunar impact crater located in the southern lunar highlands, named after the Danish astronomer Tycho Brahe. It is estimated to be 108 million years old.
d_mars_hellas_planitia_b_desc: Hellas Planitia is a plain located within the huge, roughly circular impact basin Hellas, which is located in the southern hemisphere of the planet Mars.
d_mars_hellas_planitia_c_desc: Hellas Planitia is a plain located within the huge, roughly circular impact basin Hellas, which is located in the southern hemisphere of the planet Mars.
d_mars_hellas_planitia_desc: Hellas Planitia is a plain located within the huge, roughly circular impact basin Hellas, which is located in the southern hemisphere of the planet Mars.
d_mars_northern_ice_cap_b_desc: The northern polar cap has a diameter of about 1000 km during the northern Martian summer and a thickness of two kilometres.
d_mars_northern_ice_cap_c_desc: The northern polar cap has a diameter of about 1000 km during the northern Martian summer and a thickness of two kilometres.
d_mars_northern_ice_cap_desc: The northern polar cap has a diameter of about 1000 km during the northern Martian summer and a thickness of two kilometres.
d_mars_olympus_mons_b_desc: Olympus Mons is a very large shield volcano on the planet Mars. The volcano has a height of nearly twenty five kilometres, though its slope rarely extends beyond five degrees.
d_mars_olympus_mons_c_desc: Olympus Mons is a very large shield volcano on the planet Mars. The volcano has a height of nearly twenty five kilometres, though its slope rarely extends beyond five degrees.
d_mars_olympus_mons_desc: Olympus Mons is a very large shield volcano on the planet Mars. The volcano has a height of nearly twenty five kilometres, though its slope rarely extends beyond five degrees.
d_mars_southern_ice_cap_b_desc: The southern polar cap has a diameter of about 350 km and a thickness of three kilometres.
d_mars_southern_ice_cap_c_desc: The southern polar cap has a diameter of about 350 km and a thickness of three kilometres.
d_mars_southern_ice_cap_desc: The southern polar cap has a diameter of about 350 km and a thickness of three kilometres.
d_mars_utopia_planitia_b_desc: Utopia Planitia is a vast lava plain on the planet Mars. It hosted the surface structures of a starship construction facility, the Utopia Planitia Fleet Yards, a most extensive construction yard.
d_mars_utopia_planitia_c_desc: Utopia Planitia is a vast lava plain on the planet Mars. It hosted the surface structures of a starship construction facility, the Utopia Planitia Fleet Yards, a most extensive construction yard.
d_mars_utopia_planitia_desc: Utopia Planitia is a vast lava plain on the planet Mars. It hosts the surface structures of a starship construction facility, the Utopia Planitia Fleet Yards, a most extensive construction yard.
d_mars_valles_marineris_b_desc: Valles Marineris, or Mariner Valleys, is a vast canyon system that runs along the Martian equator just east of the Tharsis region. It reaches depths up to seven kilometres.
d_mars_valles_marineris_c_desc: Valles Marineris, or Mariner Valleys, is a vast canyon system that runs along the Martian equator just east of the Tharsis region. It reaches depths up to seven kilometres.
d_mars_valles_marineris_desc: Valles Marineris, or Mariner Valleys, is a vast canyon system that runs along the Martian equator just east of the Tharsis region. It reaches depths up to seven kilometres.
d_medicinial_herbs_desc: Medicinal Herbs have been discovered and used in traditional medicine practices since prehistoric times.
d_mount_feraan_desc: Notable mountain of the Farain continent, not far from the capital city of Tarala'n.
d_mugato_world_desc: A designated sanctuary for the endangered ape-like carnivorous species. Designed to protect and allow the safe story of these rare beasts.
d_nanite_cache_desc: Large containers filled with quintillions of nanites are all that remain of the metal we harvested from this solar system.
d_nepenthe_bunnicorn_desc: The bunnicorn, which resembles a horned rabbit, uses its horn to impale and slowly poison its prey. Known for it's highly nutritious meat, the bunnicorn does present a hazard to the unwary as it's venomous sacs must be removed prior to service.
d_nepenthe_infinity_lake_desc: A vast lake whose positioning gives the impression of it merging into the surrounding landscape and horizon, giving the illusion that it goes on forever.
d_neural_providence_desc: The Hill People of Neural revere this valley due to its source of Mahko Root. The Mugato wander the rocky valley freely here, making it a dangerous journey for those Neuralese who must collect the medicine contained within.
d_new_athens_city_desc: Centaurian colony, named after their ancestral home back on Earth.
d_new_korinth_city_desc: Centaurian colony, named after their ancestral home back on Earth.
d_new_samarkand_city_desc: Named for the ancient Central Asian trading center, New Samarkand is the capital city of Kolmyri and one of the oldest Human settlements on the planet.
d_norcadia_city_desc: The vast city of Norcadia Prime contains the best, largest arenas and stadiums for combat.
d_north_star_plains_desc: Vast steppes lie here, where many farms and ranches set up shop.
d_north_star_town_desc: North Star is the name of a town on a Skagaran colony planet in the Delphic Expanse. It approximated Earth's Ancient West in the second half of the 19th century.
d_nyrian_pyramids_desc: A landmark of the Centauran civilisation in the polar region of the planet, on the continent of Nyria.
d_ocampa_underground_city_desc: After removing all the nucleogenic particles in the atmosphere, the Nacene constructed an underground settlement for the native Ocampans, in order to preserve the Ocampan civilisation.
d_pahvo_pahvans_desc: The native life on Pahvo exists in total harmony with their world, described as a 'symbiosis between nature and the living spirit'. Every tree, rock, and blade of grass on the planet vibrates with a distinct tone, combining into a unique sound that is ubiquitous on the surface.
d_pahvo_spire_desc: The native Pahvans built a large crystalline transmitter to transmit the resonant 'music' of their world to others across the galaxy.
d_pakled_gathering_spots_desc: Strange metallic structures that the Pakled gather out, what they talk about there is anyone's guess.
d_pergium_deposit_desc: Pergium, a radioactive element that is used as a source of energy, is located here.
d_pjem_luyten_hills_desc: These vast rolling hills and sharp cliffs have special meaning to the Vulcan people. The original monastery was built over three thousand years ago.
d_pralors_ruins_desc: The ruins of the capital of the Pralor people lies here, still irradiated after the Automated Personnel Units turned against their creators. Functioning machinery still produces limited amounts of Chromodynamic Power Modules for use in the creation process of the machines.
d_qonos_caves_nomat_desc: The cinders and ash from the volcanic landscape surround the caves of No'Mat, a vast chamber of lava caves where many Klingons undertake the Rite of MajQa. The heat is known to cause hallucinations and despair in even the hardiest of warriors.
d_qonos_caves_of_kahless_desc: The Caves of Kahless are a subterranean complex of chambers located in the northern polar region of Qo'noS. Named after Kahless, traditional observances of the Day of Honor are held in these caves.
d_qonos_first_city_desc: The First City of the Klingon Empire is the capital city of Qo'noS. As the seat of the Klingon High Council, it is home to the Klingon High Council Chambers as well as the Great Hall.
d_qonos_hamar_mountains_desc: The Hamar Mountains are a vast mountain range that straddles the equator of Qo'noS, filled with treacherous peaks and high winds.
d_qonos_kangs_summit_desc: Kang's Summit is one of the highest peaks located in the northern hemisphere of Qo'noS.
d_qonos_ketha_lowlands_desc: The Ketha Lowlands are known for their flat terrain, suitable for large farming settlements, but are otherwise impoverished.
d_qonos_kristak_volcano_desc: According to legend, Kahless the Unforgettable forged the first bat'leth - the Sword of Kahless - after thrusting a lock of his hair into a river of lava from the volcano's summit. Then he plunged the burning hair into the Lake of Lusor, and as it cooled, he twisted the hair into a sword.
d_qonos_lake_of_lusor_desc: The Lake of Lusor is a vast body of water located in the northern hemisphere. According to the prophecies, after plunging a lock of his hair into a river of lava from the volcano's summit, Kahless the Unforgettable forged the Sword of Kahless, the first bat'leth, by cooling and twisting the sword in the waters of the lake.
d_qonos_naval_academy_desc: Rigid training programs imbue discipline and loyalty. It is also known for being a particularly brutal experience that hardens character. Candidates enroll when they reached 12 Earth years of age, and attendance lasts four to five years. The first two years focus on primary learning under the command of a thought master and training officers.
d_qonos_river_skral_desc: The River Skral is one of the largest rivers on the planet and pours into one of the seven chimneys leading to the underground volcano system of Qo'noS. In Klingon mythology, it ran red when Kahless slew Molor.
d_qonos_saber_bears_desc: Saber bears cover this area, rendering it too dangerous for regular settlement. The signature long, blade-like claws of the saber bear can tear inattentive hunting parties apart in seconds.
d_rashtag_city_desc: A capital city of Janalwa, Rashtag is carefully planned and build in a shape of a circle with the Niamlar Circle that houses the Cathedral of State being always in it's centre.
d_relics_deposit_desc: Ancient remains of civilisations of a bygone era, these ruins contain relics of the past which hold cultural value.
d_remus_caladan_mountains_desc: Located on the starward side of the moon, the Caladan Mountains loom over the entire temperate area of Remus.
d_remus_narrow_band_desc: Where the sunward and starward hemispheres meet exists a small area where the high and low temperatures meet. These characteristics result in a temperate band racked by strong weather phenomena.
d_remus_rich_dilithium_veins_desc: Vast dilithium veins under the surface of Remus offer a large source of dilithium.
d_remus_starward_hemisphere_desc: Tidally locked, this hemisphere is constantly facing away from the star and as such, is a frozen wasteland.
d_remus_strelland_gorge_desc: Two tectonic plates separated here due to the tidally locked pressures exerted upon Remus, creating a massive deep gorge on the surface.
d_remus_sunward_hemisphere_desc: Tidally locked, this hemisphere is constantly facing towards the star and as such, is a scorched wasteland.
d_remus_weapons_testing_site_desc: The wastelands of Remus are the ideal place to test the highest yield and most dangerous weapons.
d_resort_deposit_desc:
Whether it's a tranquil view of planetary rings or a scenic vista overlooking a lava field, some places in the galaxy are just once-in-a-lifetime experiences.

Allows this world to be designated as a Resort World, which increases the immigration pull and happiness due to the outstanding beauty.
d_rigel_rralrark_desc: Rralrark is the main city of the Rigellians, known for its vast trading connections and has twisting streets crowded with a multitude of foreign merchants.
d_rinax_marshlands_desc: Filled with lavaflies, the marshlands are an inhospitable area where temperatures can reach 50 degrees Celsius and 90% humidity.
d_rinax_sun_fields_desc: Massive meadows that receive a large amount of light from Mormo, the Sun Fields are home to giant zax trees and oliara birds.
d_risa_galartha_desc: Galartha is a popular rock climbing destination. It is notable for having a cliff face that changes pitch, and handholds, as a person climbs it.
d_risa_luminescent_caves_desc: Unique flora and fungi that have evolved in the absence of light use bioluminescence to light up large caves under the ground.
d_risa_nuvia_desc: The capital of Risa, Nuvia is the location of the resort's central government.
d_risa_steam_pools_desc: The relaxing steam pools of Risa use the natural warmth of geysers and geothermal energy to provide a warming bath, even high up in the mountains.
d_risa_subterranean_gardens_desc: Below the surface of Risa, large subterranean gardens produce unique flora that can only be found on this planet.
d_risa_suraya_bay_desc: Suraya Bay is a coastal resort on the planet Risa, known for having villas built right into the cliffs. The Risian celebration known as Lohlunat is celebrated at Suraya Bay.
d_risa_temtibi_lagoon_desc: The Temtibi Lagoon is a body of water on Risa that has warm water, sweet-smelling wind, and hot springs in the surrounding area.
d_rockier_mountains_desc: A mountain range on New Montana, Rockier Mountains were named by Zefram Cochrane himself, who thoroughly enjoyed naming the many locations on the world after exploring it.
d_rom_naval_academy_desc: The Phi'lasasam Naval Academy is the primary training facility operated by the Romulan Star Navy and is located on Romulus. The Academy's primary function is to train officers for the Navy as well as serving as a command training school for experienced officer.
d_romulus_arhael_desert_desc: The Ar'hael desert covers a vast area containing millions of square kilometres of land suitable for solar power generation. With infrastructure and irrigation in place, it can now be inhabited.
d_romulus_calanista_desc:
Low fields near the river provide year round irrigation to the rich farmlands of Calanista. The area is noted for the shops of its nectar-maker, where the finest ale is produced in the galaxy.

This serves as one of the top exports of Romulus. While many imitators can be found in the outlying colonies, none can compare to Calanistan nectar.
d_romulus_dessicated_wasteland_desc: The desiccated wasteland of the Ar'hael desert remains as such due to the scorching heat and year-round aridity of the lands. Solar generation over the millions of square kilometres of land could be possible if infrastructure projects are adopted.
d_romulus_gal_gaththong_desc:
Gal Gath'thong is one of the last active volcanoes on Romulus. Mighty firefalls flow from the top of the volcano, cascade down large cliffs, and seep through gaps in the crust to return to the planet's core.

Nearby, many hot springs operate, because the area is extremely mineral rich.
d_romulus_jewelled_forest_desc:
One of the natural wonders on Romulus, the area was formed when a nearby volcano erupted, covering a large forested area. The trees died, but as time passed, the minerals in the lava and ash filtered into the wood, petrifying and preserving it. 

This led to a soft stone around the petrified trees that eroded away and left the trees standing as stony monuments to their former life of verdancy. Tiny flakes of mica and similar minerals in the bark give the trees a glittering and sparkling appearance in the light of the sun and moons.
d_romulus_kaeraktar_mountains_desc: Some of the highest peaks on Romulus are part of the Kae'raktar mountains, which stretch across the continent.
d_romulus_ki_baratan_desc:
Ki Baratan is the capital city of the Romulan Star Empire. Located on Romulus off the coast of the Apnex Sea, the city is sometimes anachronistically referred to by the old name, Dartha or Dartha City.

It has been the center of operations for the planet for many centuries and is home to most government buildings.
d_romulus_krocton_segment_desc: An urban region of the planet, the wealthy Krocton Segment is often associated with dissidents who operate out of nearby caves.
d_romulus_tal_shiar_desc: It is the third most important building in the capital, behind only the Imperial Romulan Senate and the Praetor's Palace. The Citadel is the home and headquarters of the feared Romulan intelligence service, the Tal Shiar. Many tend to avoid this structure with some even going as far as trying to prevent the shadow of the building from touching them in the belief that it would mean imprisonment within.
d_romulus_valley_of_chula_desc:
Cutting straight through the heart of the Kae'raktar Mountains, the valley is a vast region that contains the most beautiful vistas, as well as the most exquisite climate on the entire world. 

Praetors of the past occupied a Summer Palace here. Perched on the highest hill, the palace has the appearance of a gold-winged eagle looking for prey.
d_rubbish_pits_desc: Large sites filled with the scavenged remains of ships old and new, with crews of Pakleds crawling over them to obtain the best bits.
d_ruined_walledcity_desc: The ruins of the Imperial walled city of Kowloon, destroyed when the Alliance ransacked Earth.
d_ruins_dewan_desc: The Dewan Ruins contain a language derived from the ancient Iconian language. The languages have certain shared similarities, presenting the hypothesis that some Iconians were able to survive the orbital bombardment of Iconia.
d_ruins_sakethan_desc: The Sakethan culture once existed on Calder II. It left behind ancient ruins, burial mounds associated with Romulan artifacts, and many glyph stones.
d_rura_glacier_chuch_desc: Large geothermal vents burst from the surface, offering a small respite from the biting cold.
d_rura_glacier_dung_desc: A vast, open glacier with extremely high-speed winds coming from the Mek'Tush mountains.
d_rura_glacier_elth_desc: The fast moving TaD'elth glacier shifts and churns regularly, unveiling fresh new, rich dilithium deposits in shifting caverns, dangerous to those forced to mine it.
d_rura_glacier_tad_desc: A sturdy, slow-moving glacier that shifts only a few centimetres every year.
d_rura_glacier_tajchuch_desc: Tajchuh Glacier is an extremely slow-moving glacier, which regularly shifts and exposes new mineral deposits.
d_rura_glacier_wastes_desc: A vast, open wasteland that stretches for half a continent on this icy world.
d_rura_ice_caverns_desc: The ice caverns on Rure Penthe descend deep within the planet, offering rich access to crystals.
d_scarred_surface_desc: Devastated millennia ago, no one really knows what caused such rampant destruction to the surface of this world.
d_shelia_mandala_desc: Perfectly constructed over millennia, the central hub of the Sheliak is a vast intricate city, designed to represent the Sheliak's view of the cosmo and their place within it.
d_smap_fields_desc: Used for both food and textile manufacturing, Smap is an important export for Malon Sanctity.
d_sodium_deposit_desc: Yridium bicantizine and sodium sediment can be found here. It is an active ingredient for certain pharmaceutical compounds.
d_solum_time_crystal_desc: From time to time the fragments within the rings orbiting Solum fall to the planets surface forming great plains where nothing grows, but strange energies are detected. An area of great mystery and interest for the natives.
d_sona_refuge_desc: After being exiled from Ba'ku, the Son'a gathered here to create their new life, and to seek vengeance for what they perceived to be unlawful banishment.
d_sr_boronite_deposit_desc: Traces of the rare element Boronite are available here.
d_sr_deuterium_deposit_desc: Deuterium is often used as fuel in matter-antimatter reactions aboard starships.
d_sr_dilithium_orbit_deposit_desc: Easily mined from orbiting rocks and asteroids, this area offers a source of Dilithium.
d_sr_dilithium_orbit_deposit_small_desc: Easily mined from orbiting rocks and asteroids, this area offers a source of Dilithium.
d_sr_dilithium_surface_deposit_desc: Dilithium veins stretch through the underground caverns, providing a source of dilithium.
d_sr_duranium_deposit_desc: Duranium is an extremely strong, silvery metallic substance ready to be mined.
d_sr_kemocite_deposit_desc: Kemocite is a multiphasic isotope of a radiolytic compound. It has many useful capabilities as but in its purest form it can be used to create very potent explosives and fuel ship reactors.
d_sr_magnesite_deposit_desc: Magnesite is a form of Magnesium Carbonate that is able to interfere with sensor and transporter functions. It can also be used for ship hull and armor construction.
d_sr_tallonian_deposit_desc: Tallonian crystals, rare gemstones, can be easily mined here.
d_sr_time_crystal_orbit_deposit_desc: The unusual effects of stellar phenomenon such as pulsars and black holes can warp time and space just enough to create Time Crystals.
d_sr_topaline_deposit_desc: Topaline, a mineral used in life support and sensor systems, can be easily mined here.
d_sr_trellium_deposit_desc: Trellium-D is mostly used inside the Delphic Expanse to protect against dangerous anomalies. But even outside of the expanse it's used by various military facilities. It should be noted, that Trellium-D has a strong influence on Vulcans, for which it acts like a drug when nearby and completely destroys their mental control.
d_sr_water_deposit_desc: Frozen water trapped as ice on the surface of an orbital space body.
d_sr_water_desc: Deep sources from within the ice caps provide an ample supply of fresh water.
d_starfleet_academy_desc: Ex astris scientia, From the stars, knowledge, the motto of Starfleet Academy. The main purpose of this department is for the education and training of individuals for service in Starfleet.
d_starfleet_hq_ruins_desc: Starfleet Command have been destroyed by Terra Prime.
d_strategic_location_deposit_desc: A focal point of subspace communications and optical light, this location offers unique strategic advantages.
d_talax_axiana_lakes_desc: Thought to be one of the highlights of Talax, the Axiana Lakes are filled with nutrient-rich mud.
d_talax_dalibardadian_plains_desc: The Dalibardadian Plains are a massive expanse of steppes and plains.
d_talax_godo_mountains_desc: The Godo mountains are a vast mineral rich range spanning two continents.
d_talax_heelox_river_desc: The Heelox River is the widest river on Talax.
d_talax_paxau_city_desc: Paxau is the capital city of Talax.
d_talax_pyrithian_gorge_desc: The deepest gorge upon Talax, it is filled with rare materials from deep within the crust.
d_talax_riparian_corridors_desc: Riparian corridors are massive riverbanks upon which unique flora can be found.
d_talos_drake_mountains_desc: The jagged damaged Drake Mountains are a potent memorial to the devastation caused by an ancient cataclysm.
d_talos_menagerie_desc: This complex is filled with psionic energy, allowing those inside to experience life in full splendour.
d_talos_refuge_desc: The remnants of the Talosians live within this vast underground refuge, the sole survivors of a cataclysmic event that rendered the surface uninhabitable.
d_talos_ruins_desc: The ruins of a large city stand as an example of the conflict that struck Talos IV.
d_talos_salt_desc: Once a vast bed of water, the cataclysm that struck Talos IV has left these salt flats barren and plain.
d_talos_sea_desc: The western sea is a turbulent vast ocean, with only tales and glimpse of terrible psionic horrors lying underneath.
d_tarakis_monument_deactivated_desc:
The device appears to be designed to impart memories from remorseful alien soldiers who participated in a massacre of civilians on the world several centuries prior. The following is inscribed across its base: 
'Words alone cannot convey the suffering.
Words alone cannot prevent what happened here from happening again.
Beyond words lies experience.
Beyond experience lies truth.
Make this truth your own.'

The monument has been disabled.
d_tarakis_monument_desc:
The device appears to be designed to impart memories from remorseful alien soldiers who participated in a massacre of civilians on the world several centuries prior. The following is inscribed across its base: 
'Words alone cannot convey the suffering.
Words alone cannot prevent what happened here from happening again.
Beyond words lies experience.
Beyond experience lies truth.
Make this truth your own.'

The monument has been successfully repaired.
d_tarakis_monument_destroyed_desc:
The remains of a device designed to impart memories from remorseful foreign soldiers who participated in a massacre of civilians on the world several centuries prior. The following was inscribed across its base: 
'Words alone cannot convey the suffering.
Words alone cannot prevent what happened here from happening again.
Beyond words lies experience.
Beyond experience lies truth.
Make this truth your own.'

The monument has been completely destroyed.
d_tarakis_monument_faulty_desc:
The device appears to be designed to impart memories from remorseful foreign soldiers who participated in a massacre of civilians on the world several centuries prior. The following is inscribed across its base: 
'Words alone cannot convey the suffering.
Words alone cannot prevent what happened here from happening again.
Beyond words lies experience.
Beyond experience lies truth.
Make this truth your own.'

The monument appears to be partially malfunctioning.
d_taralan_city_desc: Capital city of Centaurus, Tarala'n is located just to the south of the world's equator, in the vicinity of Mount Fera'an. The city features the famous Monument of Visions Art Museum.
d_tempestuous_mountain_desc: Wind-torn vegetation clings to the high crags and stormy cliffs of these rainy mountains.
d_temporal_chamber_desc: While sending material from the future is impossible, it is more than possible to instead receive guidance and information.
d_terra_boswash_desc: This megalopolis extends all down the eastern seaboard of North America from Boston to Washington, a conglomerate of cities formed into one.
d_terra_bozeman_desc: The site of First Contact with the inferior Vulcans, Bozeman is the location where Terran might overcame the Vulcan invaders and gained access to faster-than-light travel.
d_terra_london_desc: Home to the leaders of the European Republic centuries ago, London is now a shadow of its former self.
d_terra_palace_desc: The seat of power of the Emperor or Empress of the Terran Empire, most administrative and military decrees are issued from this ancient and powerful complex.
d_terra_prison_desc: A harsh wasteland with habitable land only around the coastlines, District Australia has been the dumping ground for political miscreants for centuries.
d_terra_sanfran_desc: Known best for the megaprison of Alcatraz, San Francisco is also home to the premier crew training facilities for the Terran Empire, where countless subjects sign up to serve the glory of the Empire.
d_terra_ural_desc: The Ural Mountains are a mountain range that run approximately from north to south through Russia, from the coast of the Arctic Ocean to the Ural River and northwestern Kazakhstan. They are known for their wolves.
d_terra_walledcity_desc: The vast Walled City is the most densely populated spot on Terra, with millions of people crammed into a self-contained city filled with chaos, poverty, and vice.
d_therhea_grain_crop_desc: Therhea is a key food crop that is grown for export by Malon Sanctity.
d_tholia_lattice_desc: The lattice is what grants every Tholian their purpose.
d_tholia_lava_fields_desc: The vast lava fields of Tholia flow from volcano to ground covering a large proportion of the surface, bringing up otherwise valuable materials from the mantle of the planet.
d_time_crystals_deposit_desc: A time crystal is a structure that repeats in time, as well as in space. Normal three-dimensional crystals have a repeating pattern in space, but remain unchanged as time passes whilst time crystals repeat themselves in time as well, leading the crystal to change from moment to moment.
d_tradegood_balsotonic_desc: The Balso Springs of Trill provide an effervescent fluid that can be exported.
d_tradegood_bloodwine_desc: Centuries old vintages of the finest bloodwines from the best vinters in the Klingon Empire are stored within vast cellars under the First City.
d_tradegood_caitnip_desc: Catnip is a perennial herb from the mint family and contains high concentrations of the feline attractant nepetalactone, which Caitians and other feline races cannot resist.
d_tradegood_cheelash_desc: Only grown on Argratha, the Chee'lash fruit remains very edible, even when it has rotted. It is nutrient rich, with both vitamins and minerals.
d_tradegood_edosian_desc: Edosian orchids are a herbaceous plant which produce beautiful flowers, often used as a symbol of health amongst Cardassians. The orchid is also used by operatives as it is known to be very, very poisonous.
d_tradegood_fruitnectar_desc: The Talaxian Fruit Nectar flowers bloom only once every two years, but the harvests provide massive amounts of delicious Fruit Nectar for use.
d_tradegood_greenbread_desc: The green wheat of Yadera grows only here and allows the creation of delicious greenbread.
d_tradegood_kavanut_desc: The kava nut is one of the few foods that the Vorta can enjoy; it is a legacy of their primitive marsupial ancestors.
d_tradegood_marobroot_desc: The marob root grows only on the mountainsides of Banea, where Baneans swoop down and harvest the plant. The roots are used in teas, medicines and herbal remedies.
d_tradegood_mineralwater_desc: The water springs from the Cliffs of Bole provide a particularly flavoured mineral water.
d_tradegood_parthas_desc: Grown only on Acamar, these fields provide the nutrient-rich parthas root to the farmers.
d_tradegood_pearls_desc: Found in the oceans of Hus, the Pearls of Hus are a rare and valuable commodity.
d_tradegood_plomeek_desc: Plomeek fields provide plomeek for use in many exportable foods and produce.
d_tradegood_romulan_ale_desc: Kheh is a type of stalked grain which is an ingredient in Romulan ale. The finest grains are produced in the Rarathik District, fermenting into a potent blue liquid.
d_tradegood_saurgrapes_desc: Saurgrapes are a valuable part of the aged brandy processing that is used to make Saurian brandy.
d_tradegood_snuffbeetles_desc: The delicious snuff beetles found on Ferenginar are exported as a delicacy across the galaxy.
d_tradegood_tholia_desc: Formed by the searing hot lava filled interior of Tholia, the crystalline formations on this world are unparalleled throughout the galaxy.
d_tradegood_tuber_desc: The tuber roots grown in the ice fields of Andoria provide delicious foodstuffs for Andorians across the quadrant.
d_tradegood_tulaberry_desc: Tulaberries can be grown here and used in fruit juice, wine, or herbal remedies.
d_tradegood_uttaberry_desc: Uttaberries can be grown here and used in fruit juice, wine, or herbal remedies.
d_tradegood_valerianroot_desc: The Valerian root grows only on the hillsides of Valeria. The roots are used in teas, medicines, and herbal remedies.
d_tradegood_vermicula_desc: Vast vats of vermicula, small fish-like animals, are grown across Antedia, providing a vital delicacy for oceanic species across the quadrant.
d_tradegoods_mahkoroot_desc: The Mahko root is a plant native to the planet Neural. It is the only known cure for the poisonous bite of the deadly Mugato.
d_trellium_deposit_desc: Trellium-D is mostly used inside the Delphic Expanse to protect against dangerous anomalies. But even outside of the expanse it's used by various military facilities. It should be noted, that Trellium-D has a strong influence on Vulcans, for which it acts like a drug when nearby and completely destroys their mental control.
d_tribbles_deposit_desc: Tribbles are born pregnant. They only do two things: eat and multiply! Because of this, they can destroy the agricultural production of an entire world in a matter of weeks. While many humanoids find them to be unusually pleasant to look at and pet, Klingons fear them like nothing else.
d_tribute_soong_desc: A statue to the individual who set humanity onto its path of greatness.
d_trill_availehhirh_desc: The Ayai'leh-hirh range is the largest mountain range on the planet Trill. The name of the range translates to Five Thousand Valleys.
d_trill_caves_makala_desc: The Caves of Mak'ala are a series of interconnecting underground caves on Trill. Deep within these caves are kilometres of interconnecting pools of a milk-like substance, which is the natural environment of the Trill symbionts.
d_trill_ganses_peninsula_desc: The Ganses Peninsula stands firm against the harsh northern weather and is also the location of a university.
d_trill_hoobishan_baths_desc: The Hoobishan Baths, also known as the Baths of Trill, are a popular public bathing location in Leran Manev on Trill.
d_trill_lake_devritane_desc: Lake Devritane is a body of water on Trill, with fast flowing tributaries feeding the lake from the hills.
d_trill_lake_ograls_desc: Lake Ograls is situated high amongst the Ayai'leh-hirh and forms a natural basin surrounded by sharp peaks.
d_trill_leran_manev_desc: Leran Manev is the capital city of planet Trill. It is located on the shores of Manev Bay and not far from the foothills of Bes Manev.
d_trill_tenaran_cliffs_desc: Although the climate around the Tenaran Ice Cliffs is quite cold, with a biting wind, large snowdrifts, and permafrost, the Cliffs are a popular place for hiking.
d_tzenketh_city_desc: Tzenketh is the capital city of the Tzenkethi, and the seat of the government on Ab-Tzenketh.
d_underground_chamber_desc: Built by persons unknown, this vast subterranean chamber offers protection from the surface.
d_underground_ore_desc: Deep within the crust of this planet lie rich ore veins, offering valuable resources to those who mine them.
d_underground_soil_desc: The soils in this area are extremely mineral rich, making them ideally fertile for a vast array of foodstuffs.
d_underground_thermal_desc: Vast geothermal vents exude large amounts of heat kept within the planets mantle, allowing geothermal energy to be utilised.
d_unimatrix_node_desc: The prime unimatrix is the central location for the Borg Collective, where the royal protocols and harmonisation computers reside.
d_university_alpha_centauri_desc: An institute of higher learning dedicated to the studies in interdimensional physics, among other things.
d_vaadwaar_restored_capital_city_desc: The ruins have been swept away, and Dragon's Teeth stands anew. It is a symbol of our enduring supremacy.
d_vaadwaar_underground_bunker_desc: Armoured and hardened against orbital bombardment, this underground bunker houses key command and control personnel in the event of catastrophe.
d_vaadwaur_hangar_bay_desc: A large underground storage area containing numerous mothballed space worthy vessels, ready to be returned to duty when their occupants wake.
d_vaadwaur_ruined_capital_city_desc: The remains of a once gleaming capital city stand ruined, devastated from orbit centuries ago when lesser species rose up against the Vaadwaur. A massive reconstruction effort would be required to return this to its former glory.
d_vaadwaur_stasis_pods_desc: A large cavern contains many stasis pods, which have remained powered for centuries.
d_voth_city_bridge_desc: The main command center for the entire City Ship, where vital command and control over the vessel is conducted.
d_voth_city_hangar_desc: The cavernous hangar bays of the City Ship contain all the facilities required to build and repair new vessels.
d_voth_city_lab_desc: Onboard laboratories seek to improve the Voth, whilst maintaining a strict adherence to Doctrine.
d_voth_city_park_desc: The uppermost deck has a large domed environment reminiscent of a park upon on the Voth's planets where Voth of all circles can come to congregate and relax after their duties are finished. The domed sky offers a panoramic view of the galaxy.
d_voth_city_reactor_desc: The central reactor powers the entire city ship, generating vast amounts of surplus power.
d_voth_city_replicator_desc: Massive onboard replicators allow for the material needs of an entire population to be met with ease.
d_voth_city_residential_desc: A large section of the city ship is dedicated to quarters for the massive population of the vessel. They are divided in quality and facilities based on which circles the Voth operate in.
d_voth_city_shield_desc: Massive shield generators create a protective field, almost impenetrable to regular weapons, across the entire vessel's hull.
d_voth_city_storage_desc: Vast storage bays hold supplies of all shapes and sizes that are used to supply a population of millions.
d_vulcan_arlanga_desc: The Arlanga Mountains stretch across equatorial Vulcan from Raal in the west to Kir in the east.
d_vulcan_fire_plains_desc: The Fire Plains are a location on Vulcan that covers over 2 million hectares of land. Vast volcanic activity throughout the region gives rise to the name. Formations of multicolored crystals grow throughout the superheated environment.
d_vulcan_forge_desc: Vulcan's Forge is a vast desert on the planet Vulcan, which plays an important role in Vulcan history. According to historical record, the Forge was where Surak began his pilgrimage.
d_vulcan_lake_yuron_desc: Lake Yuron is a lake on the planet Vulcan, and is often fog-covered.
d_vulcan_mount_seleya_desc: The Mountains of Gol are a large, mountainous region located on the planet Vulcan, and the highest peak is Mount Seleya. It is said to be the place where Surak formulated his philosophies, including logic and IDIC, in the 3rd century.
d_vulcan_osana_caverns_desc: The Osana Caverns are located on Vulcan, and extend for kilometres beneath the surface.
d_vulcan_shikahr_desc: ShiKahr is the capital city of Vulcan, located on the edge of Vulcan's Forge.
d_vulcan_tkarath_sanctuary_desc: An ancient underground sanctuary under the ShiKahr district. Many relics have been found here over the centuries, but for now it appears mostly abandoned.
d_wadi_chula_desc: A massive arena where players are transported to play in the game of Chula, filled with hazards and traps to overcome.
d_wadi_surchid_desc: The capital city of Wadi is filled with gambling dens, trade opportunities and gaming stations.
d_welcoming_sea_desc: A single body of water on New Montana, that covers no more than ten percent of the planet's surface.
d_xahean_dilithium_fields_desc: Natural deposits of raw purified Dilithium.
d_zahl_zahlnerest_desc: The capital city of the Zahl, an ancient city covered with monuments and vast archives.
d_zakdorn_attica_desc: The Attica is where the Strategos and other Zakdorn wonders are located.
job_Vaharai_desc: Those Kelpiens who are Vaharai have earned the greatest honour amongst their people, to be chosen by the Watchful Eye to maintain the Great Balance.
job_abbot_desc: Leading the population on religious worlds, Abbots often have a large amount of influence.
job_administrator_UND_desc: The Undine Psi Masters have uniquely strong psychic powers used to coordinate the Undine hordes.
job_administrator_desc: Administrators are in charge of large swathes of population, and often control entire continents.
job_administrator_minister_desc: Often part of a governing parliament, ministers are elected officials tasks with administering departments.
job_administrator_vorta_desc: Tasked by the Founders to administer the population, Administrators are meticulous and vain.
job_admiral_desc: The admiralty ensures the fleet is well supplied and crewed.
job_alcove_drone_desc: Unit has returned to the regeneration cycle to concentrate on maintenance and repair work.
job_alien_overseer_desc: Overseers enforce the will of the authority on the planet, ensuring the population obeys.
job_ambassador_desc: Ambassadors represent their entire world upon the democratic Federation Council.
job_artisan_jevonite_desc: Jevonite is a rare and highly prized mineral stone found in some Cardassian worlds, with only the most skilled jewellers able to shape it.
job_assembly_crew_drone_borg_desc: This type of drone is outfitted to retrofit drones with new technology and enhancements.
job_assembly_crew_drone_desc: Outfitted with precision sensors and unique chromodynamic handling capabilities, these assemblers can construct new APUs.
job_bajoran_ranjen_desc: Religious leader who provides spiritual guidance and wisdom within the Bajoran community.
job_bio_assembler_undine_desc: Spawners manage and coordinate new Undine into the Vanguard.
job_borg_pre_assimilated_desc: These pops have begun to submit to the Borg assimilation process following the insertion of Borg nanoprobes into their bodies & whilst they have yet to become full drones, they can hear the voice of the collective growing louder.
job_brain_drone_borg_desc: The vast archives of the Collective must be curated and pruned by Archival drones whenever new information arrives.
job_caretaker_desc: The maintenance and restocking of a reservation requires a skilled specialist who understands the balance of each part of the reservations ecosystem.
job_chief_engineer_officer_desc: Leads the engineering team, supervises the maintenance and optimisation of all technical systems.
job_chief_science_officer_desc: Oversees scientific experiments and analyses data to support the mission.
job_chief_tactical_officer_desc: Monitors weapons and defence systems and coordinates tactical operations during the mission.
job_chromodynamic_drone_desc: Equipped with extremely accurate sensors and dexterity upgrades, chromodynamic manufacturers are capable of producing the rare Chromodynamic Power Modules that are required for synthetic life replication.
job_commerce_bajoran_desc: As part of the D'jarra, Mi'tino traders occupy an import position in the influx and export of common goods.
job_commerce_desc: Buying low and selling high, traders can sniff out a profit.
job_commerce_machine_desc: Combining the correct mixture of atoms to create specific pieces of matter can only be done by dedicated matter synthesisers.
job_commerce_smuggler_desc: A smuggler is an individual who deals with the secret exchanged shipment of goods to evade restrictions or tax fees.
job_commodore_desc: Commodores are often employed to command smaller detachments of vessels.
job_communications_officer_desc: Manages and coordinates all communication systems for effective contact and information exchange.
job_crime_boss_desc: Master of the underground criminal empire.
job_dabo_girl_desc: Dabo girls are females of various species chosen for their apparent beauty, often employed as part of the roulette-style game of chance called Dabo.
job_diplomat_desc: Diplomats are trusted with maintaining relations amongst the many different species of the galaxy.
job_dummy_tyrant_desc: Authoritarian leader who exercises absolute control over the government and population.
job_enforcer_hirogen_desc: The Prey Wardens ensure that worthy prey are cared for before the next great hunt, as well as ensure that none escape their enclosures.
job_enforcer_starfleet31_desc: The mysterious operatives from Section 31 will go to any lengths to ensure that Starfleet and her allies come out on top.
job_engineer_officer_desc: Monitors and repairs technical systems to ensure safe operation.
job_entertainer_jemhadar_desc: Fighting in the arenas until submission or death is entertainment for many sections of the populace.
job_ex_borg_desc: Former member of the Borg collective who was freed from assimilation and is trying to reintegrate into society.
job_farmer_undine_desc: The Undine are experts in manipulating the unique properties of Fluidic Space.
job_founder_infiltrator_desc: Operating in secret, a handful of changelings can control the very fabric of galactic diplomacy.
job_founder_yeslink_desc: As part of the link, Founders are one.
job_freedom_fighter_desc: Campaigns against oppression and fights for the self-determination of his people.
job_gorn_infant_desc: The feral hatchlings of the Gorn, constantly fighting for dominance and a place within the adult hegemony.
job_gorn_livestock_desc: Slaves of the Gorn, used as live prey for their young or breeding sacs to host their hatchlings. A terrible fate for anyone.
job_healthcare_GENE_desc: A biologist who studies genetics, the science of genes, heredity, and variation of organisms.
job_healthcare_GENE_drone_desc: A drone designed to study genetics, the science of genes, heredity, and variation of organisms.
job_healthcare_vidiian_honatta_desc: Honatta harvest organs and biomatter from others, typically from corpses, to transplant into those suffering from the Phage.
job_high_senator_desc: Highly placed and senior senators eventually become members in the powerful and secretive Continuing Committee - the highest governing body in the Empire. The Committee acts as a regulatory body, capable of keeping both the Senate and even the Praetor in check.
job_hirogen_worthy_prey_desc: These prey are worthy of conservation and breeding programs, as they provide good sport. They are chosen for their strength and cunning amongst the prey species of the galaxy, and make the finest trophies. Cowards and weaklings are not worth considering.
job_holo_commodore_desc: Emergency Command Hologram, can be deployed to command situations to marshal and control any situation.
job_holo_healthcare_desc: Emergency Medical Holograms supplement a staff of doctors and healthcare professionals to care for their patients.
job_holo_scientist_desc: Capable of performing multiple experiments and containing the collective knowledge of society.
job_honored_first_desc: Those who are Firsts among Firsts are known as Honoured Firsts.
job_horta_borer_desc: Boring new tunnels deep within the ground, the Borers job is to find new mineral deposits.
job_horta_clutch_aunt_desc: Guardians of the eggs that are left by other Horta, each Clutch Aunt is part of the extended family.
job_horta_stone_archivist_desc: The history of the Horta is etched in the structures and walls by the Stone Archivists
job_ketracel_white_addict_desc: The feared condition that occurs when the Jem'Hadar are starved of the Ketracel White drug they need to survive.
job_liquidator_desc: A Liquidator is a feared position within the Ferengi Alliance as they are agents of the Ferengi Commerce Authority. They are answerable to the Board of Liquidators who are part of that Authority, itself headed by the Chief Liquidator.
job_maintenance_drone_borg_desc: Better than a quaternary adjunct, but not as good as a secondary adjunct.
job_maintenance_drone_robot_desc: Universal adapters, repair nanites and power supplies allow custodian drones to undertake a variety of technical jobs efficiently.
job_medical_intern_desc: Supports medical staff and gains practical experience in patient care.
job_nanite_drone_desc: Harvesting the nanites from the growth facilities requires drones with sub molecular sensors and tools.
job_noble_klingon_desc: Those who sit on the High Council are known as Councilors, and are usually the respected heads of major houses.
job_organ_storage_desc: These are living containers for organs not yet needed for transplantation into those suffering from the ravages of diseases like the Phage. Only strong, healthy specimens possess organs suitable for transplant.
job_overlord_ambassador_dom_desc: Enforcing the will of the Founders across all subjects of the Great Link.
job_overlord_ambassador_kdf_desc: Responsible for overseeing and ensuring the will of the Empire is enforced across all planets and subjects.
job_overlord_fed_ambassador_desc: Representing the Federation across its member worlds and ensuring the cohesion of the United Federation of Planets.
job_overlord_tax_collector_desc: The Overlord should always take a cut of their subjects profits and the tax collector makes this happen.
job_patrol_drone_borg_desc: Better than a tertiary adjunct, but not as good as a primary adjunct.
job_patrol_drone_undine_desc: Ensures order within the Hive and that all members work for the good of the species.
job_prey_desc: The way a creature behaves when it is wounded is the key to its destruction, and these prey are no different. They are hunted for sport and trophies taken based on how difficult the hunt was. Cowards and weaklings are poor sport.
job_prisoner_desc: Prisoners eke out their existence within this high security facility.
job_queen_adjunct_drone_desc:
Queen adjunct drones are found only on the primary Unicomplex hub. They filter and coordinate the vast amount of information flowing through the hive mind, making it easier for the Collective to administer its empire.

Reduces effective empire size by -1% for every assimilated species, to a maximum of -75% 

Increases available envoys by +1 for every 10 assimilated species, to a maximum of +6
job_researcher_engineering_desc: Chemists study the composition of matter and its properties, and carefully describe the properties they study in terms of quantities, with detail on the level of molecules and their component atoms. Chemists carefully measure substance proportions, reaction rates, and other chemical properties.
job_researcher_physics_desc: Uncovering the secrets of the universe, a physicist is a scientist who specialises in the field of physics, which encompasses the interactions of matter and energy at all length and time scales in the physical universe.
job_researcher_society_desc: A biologist is a scientist who has specialised knowledge in the field of biology, the scientific study of life. Biologists involved in fundamental research attempt to explore and further explain the underlying mechanisms that govern the functioning of living matter. Biologists involved in applied research attempt to develop or improve more specific processes and understanding, in fields such as medicine and industry.
job_robot_organic_battery_desc: Organics that serve the sole purpose of ensuring the operational status of their mechanical betters.
job_roboticist_dominion_desc: The production and growth of clones is a highly time consuming and delicate process.
job_roboticist_dred_desc: The Drednok is considered the finest mechanical creation by many and it takes a very specialist mind and set of skills to craft these robots.
job_roboticist_holo_desc: Experts in the design and build of holographic designs.
job_senior_ambassador_desc: Represents his government in diplomatic matters and promotes interstellar relations and negotiations.
job_ship_chef_desc: Prepares meals for the crew and ensures a balanced diet during the mission.
job_shipyard_worker_desc: Highly skilled workers capable of operating the technology and machinery required to create starships.
job_slave_camp_desc: Ensuring the productivity of those kept in the labour camps is the job of the wardens, who maintain the workforce and ensure any expired stock are replaced quickly.
job_slave_orion_desc: The slave auctions require management in order to maximise profit. These auctioneers pride themselves on selling the right slave to the right customer at the right time.
job_slave_terran_desc: Extracting information from different species and enacting punishments to slaves is the forté of torturers.
job_slave_vidiian_desc: How much do fresh organs from a new species with a 99% compatibility with Vidiian physiology go for? I don't know, but these slave auctioneers for the Vidiians certainly do.
job_soldier_UND_desc: Specially modified agents of the Undine, with the ability to take on the appearance of other species.
job_soldier_gunner_desc: A soldier whose life is satisfied by watching the skies and bringing down enemy aircraft.
job_soldier_superior_gladiator_desc: Those who fight for sport are a different breed to those who do it out of necessity. Gladiators often become larger than life, with huge followings.
job_spawning_drone_borg_desc: Utilising doses of nanites, nursery drones can ensure the continued growth of the Borg Collective.
job_starfleet_admiral_desc: Oversees strategic operations, commands fleet formations, and makes high-level decisions for Starfleet.
job_starfleet_captain_desc: Commands the starship, makes important decisions and represents Starfleet in all missions.
job_starfleet_commander_desc: Assists the captain in managing the crew and takes over his duties in his absence.
job_starfleet_pilot_desc: Responsible for navigating and steering the ship through space.
job_starfleet_recruit_desc: This recruit was top of his class at Starfleet Academy.
job_student_desc: Educating the youth for the future is of vital importance to space-faring nations.
job_surgeon_denobulan_desc: The tight groups of communal families of Denobula are generally led by surgeons who are well respected and renowned.
job_synapse_drone_borg_desc: The firing of certain complex operations requires key units within the Collective, controlled by Primary Adjuncts to ensure the continual operation of drones across the unified consensus.
job_talos_observer_desc: The observers tend to the Menagerie, seeking a species to repopulate the planet.
job_terraformer_desc: The operation of complex machinery used in terraforming situations is usually left to qualified Terraformers, who can study the planetary changes that are occuring.
job_test_pilot_desc: Conducts flight tests to evaluate and refine new technologies and systems.
job_tosk_desc: Tosk are a reptilian species native to the Gamma Quadrant. They don't not have personal designations, and 'Tosk' - once one is aware of the role of the Tosk in their native society - pretty much sums up everything about them and their purpose in life.
job_undine_artisan_desc: Specially bred Undine artists who sculpt the Bio-matter to create unique goods for the Undine Hive.
job_undine_factory_desc: Specially bred drones developed to harvest alloys from the planets surface.
job_undine_infester_desc: The infesters marshal and manage the infestation on a planet.
job_undine_livestock_desc: The inferior organic have no place in Undine society, they are rounded up ready to be infested and broken down to resupply the biomass reserves.
job_undine_organic_battery_desc: The dreaded machine has no place in Undine society, they are rounded up ready to be infested and broken down to resupply the biomass reserves.
job_undine_toiler_desc: Undine Gatherers scour Fluidic space for resources for the whole.
sr_boronite_desc:
Resource Category: Rare

An Omega molecule is a highly unstable molecule believed to be the most powerful substance known to exist. The molecule could be synthesized with sufficient amounts of boronite ore.

Omega Molecules can be produced by the Borg in Omega Facilities.
sr_brizeen_desc:
Resource Category: Common

Brizeen Nitrate is an extremely potent fertilizer that is used all over the galaxy. Just fifty tons of the material is enough to fertilize an entire continent.

This deposit can be collected from rare ground deposits, manufactured by intensive Soil Enrichment Centres, or imported via Starport.

Brizeen Nitrate is used to construct and support ground farms and agricultural districts.

All common materials are used in the development and upkeep of your civilian economy.
sr_cordrazine_desc:
Resource Category: Common

Cordrazine is a powerful stimulant used to revive patients in an emergency. Overdoses cause hallucinations, madness and death.

This deposit must be produced from medicinal ground deposits or imported via Starport.

Cordrazine is used to construct and maintain advanced hospital structures. All common materials are used in the development and upkeep of your civilian economy.
sr_crew_desc:
Trained crew are equipped to operate starships and their systems.

£ Trained Officers can be trained in Academies and Naval Headquarters.
sr_deuterium_desc:
Resource Category: Common

Deuterium is often used as fuel in matter-antimatter reactions aboard starships.

This deposit must be collected by an orbital mining station, manufactured by Neutron Enrichers, or imported via Starport.

Deuterium is used to construct and maintain industrial and commercial districts. All common materials are used in the development and upkeep of your civilian economy.
sr_dilithium_desc:
Resource Category: Common

Dilithium is the currency on which every modern space fleet runs. It is a vital resource for most warp civilisations as it controls the matter-antimatter reactors.

£ Dilithium can be mined from £ Dilithium deposits or found in orbital deposits, or manufactured synthetically.

Dilithium is used to construct and maintain warp engines on military and civilian ships.
sr_duranium_desc:
Resource Category: Common

Duranium plates are an extremely strong metallic substance that is used in alloys for hull construction of starships.

This deposit must be collected by an orbital mining station, purified in Duranium forges from alloy or imported via Starport.

Duranium is used to upgrade advanced starbases as well as construct starbase defensive platforms and large megastructures. All common materials are used in the development and upkeep of the civilian economy.
sr_holographic_desc:
Resource Category: Common

Allows for the construction of Holographic resources on a planet.
sr_kemocite_desc:
Resource Category: Uncommon

Kemocite is a multiphasic isotope of a radiolytic compound. It has many useful capabilities but in its purest form it can be used to create very potent torpedo weapons.

This deposit must be collected by an orbital mining station or imported via Starport.

All uncommon strategic resources are used to construct advanced components on military ships.
sr_ketracel_white_desc:
Resource Category: Rare

Ketracel White, or simply White, is an addictive narcotic chemical compound containing an isogenic enzyme. One of its active ingredients is yridium bicantizine. Jem'Hadar soldiers of the Dominion are genetically engineered to lack the enzyme that White provides, meaning they require frequent doses of the drug to survive.
sr_latinum_desc:
Resource Category: Rare

Latinum is a silver translucent liquid, used as a currency on many worlds. Since it can't be replicated and is extremely rare, it is considered very valuable.

1 £ Latinum is produced from every 20 £ trade value.
sr_luxuries_desc:
Resource Category: Common

Whilst consumer goods meet the requirements of a vast portion of the populace, luxuries are available only to a select few, whether it is down to quality, opulence or simply scarcity.

This deposit must be produced from rare ground deposits or imported via Starport.

Luxuries are required to construct and maintain education and administrative districts. All common materials are used in the development and upkeep of your civilian economy.
sr_magnesite_desc:
Resource Category: Uncommon

Magnesite is a form of magnesium carbonate that is able to interfere with sensor and transporter functions. It can also be used for ship hull construction.

This deposit must be collected by an orbital mining station or imported via Starport.

All uncommon strategic resources are used to construct advanced components on military ships.
sr_new_horizons_desc:
Resource Category: Impossible

Dev Note: Will never appear in game, used as a dummy resource.
sr_pergium_desc:
Resource Category: Rare

Pergium is an energy source that is used by over a thousand worlds all over the galaxy. It can produce a large amount of energy compared to other fuels and thus is mostly used in large scale terrestial reactors.

This deposit must be collected by an orbital mining station, found in rare £ Pergium ground deposits or imported via Starport.

Pergium is used in the construction of exotic reactor utilities on military ships, or the creation of clean and efficient terrestrial power sources.
sr_tallonian_desc:
Resource Category: Uncommon

Tallonian crystals are a very rare type gemstone that, after processing, can be used as a focusing crystal inside the energy matrix of most energy weapons. Due to their volatile weaponised nature, trading the crystals is often banned by lesser species.

This deposit must be collected by an orbital mining station or imported via Starport.

All uncommon strategic resources are used to construct advanced components on military ships.
sr_time_crystal_desc:
Resource Category: Rare

A time crystal is a rare mineral with a non-equilibrium matter state, inherently unstable with an unpredictable decay rate. Exploiting the crystals is required for certain temporal technologies.

This deposit must be found in very rare ground deposits.

Time Crystals are required to construct exotic temporal weapons, components and armies.
sr_topaline_desc:
Resource Category: Uncommon

Initial uses for the rare mineral Topaline consisted of usage in life support systems, but further studies of the mineral found that it has unique properties that improve the strength of a ship's shields.

This deposit must be collected by an orbital mining station or imported via Starport.

All uncommon strategic resources are used to construct advanced components on military ships.
sr_trellium_desc:
Resource Category: Rare

Trellium-D is mostly used inside the Delphic Expanse to protect against dangerous anomalies. It should be noted, that Trellium-D has a strong influence on Vulcans, for which it acts like a drug when nearby and completely destroys their mental control.

This deposit must be collected by an orbital mining station, found in rare £ Trellium ground deposits or imported via Starport.

Trellium-D is used in the construction of exotic armor components.
sr_water_desc:
Resource Category: Common

Frozen into a solid state, water-ice is often found on arctic worlds.

This deposit must be mined from rare deposits on the surface of a world, from orbital deposits on icy planets, manufactured by Industrial Water Extractors or imported via Starport.

Water is used to construct and maintain hydroponic farms and city districts. All common materials are used in the development and upkeep of your civilian economy.
